abort.already_configured: The lab is already set up.

set.name: Set simulated values
set.description: Sets values of the simulated sensors, for example breath_rate, temperature, door, presence, smoke, internet.

ai.name: Script the AI
ai.description: Sets what the simulated AI answers: mode answer with optional fields, error, or slow.

tap.name: Tap a notification button
tap.description: Acts like a parent tapping Seen or Quiet on the notification.

reset.name: Reset the recordings
reset.description: Forgets the recorded pushes, AI calls and siren switches.
